action_summary: Replace the sole v113 double-head prediction with an equal probability blend of the existing X3D and raw EEG families, averaging checkpoints and existing hemisphere views within each family. Historical improvements from adding these families motivate recovering ensemble diversity and excluding the sharply regressed double-head redesign; preserve trained architectures, strict checkpoint loading, filter bounds, and current time-reversal behavior. Reuse loaded models across hemisphere views, load checkpoint tensors on CPU, release models between checkpoints, and halve X3D loader batches to accommodate internal time-reversal TTA. Validate and normalize final probabilities, retain the required submission.csv schema and Kaggle paths, and replace notebook shell copies with Python equivalents. No training or inference was run; leaderboard improvement and checkpoint compatibility cannot be measured without the data and attached weights.
